subject: MAP alignment: mop-up sprint, procurement liaison & revised close window
messages:
From: Sally Huang <sally.h@veloxhealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: final acceptance window & procurement constraints

Hi Ben / Laura,

Quick note from the Velox side after this morning's sync — our internal acceptance testing slipped by one week due to an integration bug on our side. That pushes our original close window out and tightens the procurement timeline. Procurement has asked for a completed questionnaire and PO terms before we sign off on any new dates.

Key constraints: 
- Acceptance window now targeted week of Nov 29 (was Nov 22)
- Procurement needs PO template + signed terms by Nov 19 to hit that window
- Budget owner (Marco) wants visibility into any potential credits if we need to extend testing again

Can Redwood propose a short remediation / mop-up plan we can attach to the MAP (no more than two weeks of focused fixes and verification)? Procurement flagged change-order language they want included. Attaching the questionnaire they asked us to start.

Attachments: Velox_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Sally
Sally Huang
Head of Product Ops, Velox Health
Sally.H@veloxhealth.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Huang <sally.h@veloxhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: final acceptance window & procurement constraints

Sally — thanks for the heads up and for the questionnaire. We can absolutely scope a targeted mop-up sprint and embed it into the MAP so procurement has a clear SOW and timeline. Proposed quick wins:

- Two-week mop-up sprint (Nov 15–Nov 26) focused on the integration failing tests you called out
- Daily 15-min standups during the sprint between Velox eng + Redwood integration lead (Priyom)
- Deliverables: patch branch, regression test-results, acceptance checklist & sign-off form
- Fallback: if acceptance slips further, we trigger a short-term credit (equivalent to one week of reserved capacity) and a canary route to keep production stable

Can you confirm Marco is ok with the credit ask as a contingency? If so, we'll draft the MAP update and a minimal change-order clause for procurement to review. I've attached a working MAP worksheet and a PO template draft for your team to review.

Attachments: MAP-mop-up-sprint.xlsx, PO-template-velox.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive – Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0183

Sally / Ben — adding a quick escalation note: if acceptance shifts beyond Nov 29, we should be prepared to escalate to a commercial credit request and involve Legal for a brief redline of the change-order language. I recommend we: 

- Lock the mop-up sprint dates now (Nov 15–26) and publish a MAP addendum which ties acceptance criteria to sign-off owners
- Ask procurement to confirm PO timing by Nov 19; if PO slips, we treat it as an acceptance gating issue and follow the credit/escalation path
- Priyom, please outline the minimum staffing commitment for the sprint (engineer-days and on-call hours) so procurement sees direct cost impact

From: Procurement <procurement@veloxhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.d@veloxhealth.com>, Sally Huang <sally.h@veloxhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: final acceptance window & procurement constraints

Laura / Ben — procurement here. Quick responses to the asks: 

- We can accept a short mop-up SOW appended to the MAP but we need the PO and the change-order clause finalized by Nov 19 to commit budget for the week of Nov 29 acceptance.
- Marco confirms the credit contingency is acceptable in principle but Procurement needs the exact language and a cost estimate for the sprint (engineer-days + any reserved capacity hours).
- Attached is a PO template with our preferred terms; we will run any change-order through our standard approval path which takes ~3 business days.

DocuSign link for PO template: https://app.docusign.com/exec?doc=velox-po-template
Attachments: PO-template-velox.xlsx

Please send the sprint staffing estimate and the redline for change-order language by EOD Monday (Nov 8) so we can begin internal review.

Thanks,
Velox Procurement
procurement@veloxhealth.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Huang <sally.h@veloxhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@veloxhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marco Diaz <marco.d@veloxhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: final acceptance window & procurement constraints

Thanks all — summary & next steps (to be added to the MAP addendum):

1) Mop-up sprint scope & dates
   - Dates: Nov 15–Nov 26 (two weeks)
   - Staff: 2x Redwood engineers full time (Priyom lead) + on-call rotation M-F 9am–5pm PT
   - Deliverables: patch branch, regression report, acceptance checklist with sign-off fields
   - Estimated cost: equivalent of 16 engineer-days + 40 reserved capacity GPU-hours (detailed breakouts attached)

2) Procurement items
   - Redwood will redline the PO template and include a single change-order clause referencing the MAP addendum
   - Proposed contingency: 1-week credit of reserved capacity if acceptance is delayed beyond Nov 29 due to Velox-side gating issues
   - Ben to upload redline + cost breakout by EOD Monday Nov 8

3) Governance & escalation
   - Daily 15-min standups during sprint (Velox eng + Priyom)
   - Weekly exec sync (Ben + Laura + Marco + Sally) — next one Nov 18 to confirm go/no-go for acceptance window
   - If PO not returned by Nov 19, treat as procurement gating and escalate to finance owners for expedited approval

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5982 | MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-MAP-mop-up | Jira ticket INF-7123
